title: Stable evaluation regression caused by preprocessing-profile drift

failure_signature.observed: Repeated accuracy stabilized at 0.71875 while the registered historical baseline was about 0.978125.
failure_signature.distinguishing_fact: Current preprocessing profile was train_augmented; registered historical profile was eval_standard.

resolution.rollback: Discard the fresh sandbox and retain the original workspace unchanged.

reuse_guidance: Match the failure signature only after collecting fresh evidence for the new incident.
Prefer a one-variable preprocessing-profile experiment when checkpoint, data, metric, and repeat stability rule out alternatives.
Require a fresh sandbox, offline runner, explicit approval, protected hashes, and independent recomputation.
limitations: One deterministic CPU demo fixture; not evidence of production scale, distributed execution, or universal root-cause accuracy.
